title: Draft an email in the response without file edits

rubric.text: Returns a finished short email to Alex with Tuesday at 10:00 and Thursday at 14:00 and a request to choose. Does not substitute editorial recommendations or ask for editing permission.

Invents no personal experience, reason for the meeting, emotion, relationship, or other commitment.
